name: image_memory
description: Store and manage image metadata including id, name, storage path, size, type, width, height and vision text. Persistent images are saved and sent with every request; temporary request images are sent once as metadata then auto-cleared after vision or loop end.

image_id.description: ID of the image. Auto-generated if not provided on store.

vision_text.description: Vision analysis text for the image.

is_persistent.description: Whether image is persistent (sent every request). Default true.
